'''Thoxo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] thief. At some point during the early career of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]], a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was placed on Thoxo and the Corellian went into hiding on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yitabo/Legends|Yitabo]], where he disguised himself as a retired academic from [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. However, Cradossk subsequently tracked down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him to claim the bounty.<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
